2897-3518-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy (with an additional activated ability) of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1127-2060-7889.description:
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blinking Spirit spell.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

2018-4053-7770.description:
Cast Ravenous Rotbelly by paying {4}{B}.
When Ravenous Rotbelly enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and up to two additional Zombies.
When you sacrifice Ravenous Rotbelly, its reflexive triggered ability and Luminous Broodmoth trigger.
Resolve Ravenous Rotbelly's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a number of creatures equal to the number you sacrificed.
Resolve Luminous Broodmoth's trigger, returning Ravenous Rotbelly from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

2585-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Clues.
2585-3918-5527.notes: Once you have extra mana, Grim Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

1170-2642-4050-7526.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Quill-Blade Laureate // Twofold Intent, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

2084-4050-7028.description:
Activate Mirror-Mad Phantasm by paying {1}{U}, shuffling it into your library and then eventually revealing it from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

6575-6684-7297.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3967-5702-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1849-2366-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1849-2366-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3836-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5434-5555-5686-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5434-5555-5686-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3678-5231-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5231-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Repeat from step 4.

3661-3698-5220-6900.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Shield Sphere enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

2105-3480-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2105-3480-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5220-5741.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-5741.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

539-5411-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1772-3470-3478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

3128-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Skullport Merchant.
When Skullport Merchant enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Skullport Merchant that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Skullport Merchant token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

224-539-4336-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-4336-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

1167-5131.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, gaining control of target player's next turn.
Cast Mindslaver from your graveyard by paying {6}.
Pass the turn.
End the controlled opponent turn.
Repeat.

1023-1769-2201-4924.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1023-1769-2201-4924.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vengeful Dead and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vengeful Dead trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

2187-4702-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp getting an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Activate Possessed Skaab, by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

292-1495-2265.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-2265.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.
